_comment: Maps ML complaint categories to backend-aligned department names. Department labels match the Smart Complaint backend seed (backend/prisma/seed.ts). Customize freely - the recommendation engine loads this file at startup.

Water Supply.reason: Complaint relates to water availability or pipeline service disruption.

Roads.reason: Complaint relates to road surface or road infrastructure.

Garbage/Waste.reason: Complaint relates to garbage collection or solid waste.

Drainage.reason: Complaint relates to drainage or sewage.

Street Lights.reason: Complaint relates to street lighting infrastructure.

Public Transport.reason: Complaint relates to public transport services.

Traffic.reason: Complaint relates to traffic or vehicle movement.

Public Safety.reason: Complaint involves a public safety hazard.

Sanitation.reason: Complaint relates to cleanliness or hygiene.

Other.reason: Complaint does not clearly match a specific department.
